Both teams avoid getting penalized. Notre Dame leads the FBS averaging 29.4 penalty yards per game, and Navy ranks 11th with a 39.3-yard average. Notre Dame is 89th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 86.7% of trips. Navy's red zone offense ranks 27th, scoring on 91.3% of red zone opportunities. Notre Dame ranks 15th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 32:59. Team leaders Notre Dame Passing: C.J. Carr, 1,639 yards, 16 TDs, 1 INT, 66.8 completion percentage Rushing: Jonaz Walton, 426 yards on 57 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Jordan Faison, 451 yards on 34 catches, 4 TDs Navy Passing: Jackson Gutierrez, 692 yards, 7 TDs, 1 INT, 50.8 completion percentage Rushing: Gutierrez, 868 yards on 150 carries, 12 TDs Receiving: Jordan Collins, 212 yards on 6 catches, 3 TDs Last game Notre Dame fell 28-24 to BYU on Oct. 17. Carr threw for 261 yards on 27-of-49 attempts (55.1%) with no touchdowns and no interceptions.
